_note: Primary fields the extractor looks for. Values are always copied as written in the source document, with a verbatim quote. doc_types are hints for which documents to search.
_critical_note: critical: true (V1 item 8.2, proposal for clinical sign-off): read from a scanned page (vision reader transcription), the value needs one clinician confirmation against the image (confirm_value) before it counts for the Pre-Authorization; a value read from a PDF text layer, or the same value in a non-scanned verified record, needs none. Proposal: PD-L1, EGFR, ALK, ROS1, ER, PR, HER2, Ki-67, MMR, RAS / BRAF, stage as recorded (also the FIGO stage as recorded, V1 item 9.2).

ecog.label: ECOG performance status
ecog.desc: ECOG / WHO performance status as written

tobacco_use.label: Tobacco use
tobacco_use.desc: tobacco habits as written: chewing (gutka, khaini, mawa, betel quid / paan with tobacco) and smoking (bidi, cigarette), with amount and duration

clinical_question.label: Question for the Tumour Board
clinical_question.desc: the clinical question the treating team asks the board

recorded_stage.label: Stage as recorded
recorded_stage.desc: TNM / stage exactly as written by the reporting clinician (never derive)

figo_stage.label: FIGO stage as recorded
figo_stage.desc: FIGO stage exactly as written by the clinician or the reporting doctor, with the FIGO version if stated (for example 'FIGO 2018 Stage IIB'); never derive

lesion_size.label: Primary lesion size
lesion_size.desc: size of the primary lesion as written in the imaging report

depth_of_invasion.label: Depth of invasion (DOI)
depth_of_invasion.desc: depth of invasion of the primary tumour as written (for example 'Depth of invasion about 12 mm'), in a pathology or imaging report

parametrial_involvement.label: Parametrial involvement
parametrial_involvement.desc: parametrial involvement as written (for example 'left parametrium involved, not reaching the lateral pelvic wall')

ene.label: Extranodal extension (ENE)
ene.desc: extranodal / extracapsular / perinodal extension of nodal disease as written

distant_findings.label: Distant disease (imaging)
distant_findings.desc: statement about distant metastatic disease as written

comparison_prior.label: Comparison with prior imaging
comparison_prior.desc: comparison with an earlier study, as written

histologic_type.label: Histologic type
histologic_type.desc: tumour histologic type / diagnosis line as written

grade.label: Grade / differentiation
grade.desc: histologic grade or differentiation as written

pni.label: Perineural invasion (PNI)
pni.desc: perineural invasion or perineural spread as written

pdl1.label: PD-L1
pdl1.desc: PD-L1 result (TPS/CPS, clone) as written, including 'Pending'; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

egfr.label: EGFR
egfr.desc: EGFR mutation result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

alk.label: ALK
alk.desc: ALK result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

ros1.label: ROS1
ros1.desc: ROS1 result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

met.label: MET
met.desc: MET result (exon 14 skipping / amplification) as written, including 'Pending'; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

kras.label: KRAS
kras.desc: KRAS result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

er.label: Estrogen receptor (ER)
er.desc: ER result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

pr.label: Progesterone receptor (PR)
pr.desc: PR result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

her2.label: HER2
her2.desc: HER2 result as written (IHC score and/or ISH result); the final reported status if given; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

ki67.label: Ki-67
ki67.desc: Ki-67 index as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

mmr.label: MMR / MSI status
mmr.desc: mismatch repair IHC or MSI result as written; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

ras_braf.label: RAS / BRAF
ras_braf.desc: KRAS/NRAS/BRAF result as written, including 'Not performed'; if the report says the test is pending, sent out or awaited, copy that statement as the value

distance_from_anal_verge.label: Distance from anal verge
distance_from_anal_verge.desc: tumour distance from the anal verge as written

mrf_status.label: Mesorectal fascia (MRF)
mrf_status.desc: MRF / CRM status on MRI as written

emvi.label: EMVI
emvi.desc: extramural venous invasion on MRI as written

wbc.label: WBC count
wbc.desc: total white cell count with unit, or 'Not reported' if so written

hiv_status.label: HIV status
hiv_status.desc: HIV test result as written (for example 'HIV I and II antibodies: Non-reactive')

treatment_received.label: Treatment received
treatment_received.desc: treatment delivered as documented (dose, fractions, agents, dates)

treatment_completion_date.label: Treatment completion date
treatment_completion_date.desc: date the documented treatment course was completed

dental_evaluation.label: Dental evaluation
dental_evaluation.desc: the pre-treatment dental evaluation as written: dental findings, OPG (orthopantomogram) findings, extractions or dental care advised before treatment

patient_preference.label: Patient preference / special circumstances
patient_preference.desc: documented patient preference, consent or special circumstances (for example declines surgery, lives far away, financial constraints) as written

patient_awareness.label: Patient knows the diagnosis
patient_awareness.desc: whether the patient has been told the diagnosis (yes, no, partly), as the treating doctor states it

clinical_trial_note.label: Clinical trial availability / suitability
clinical_trial_note.desc: any documented statement about clinical trial availability or suitability, as written

diagnosis_date_mode.label: Date and mode of diagnosis
diagnosis_date_mode.desc: the date and the way the diagnosis was established (for example biopsy on 08-Sep-2026) as written

presenting_complaint.label: Presenting complaints
presenting_complaint.desc: the presenting / chief complaints and their duration as written (for example 'haemoptysis for 6 weeks')

tumour_site_colon.label: Colon segment of the tumour
tumour_site_colon.desc: segment of the colon where the tumour sits as written (caecum, ascending colon, hepatic flexure, transverse colon, splenic flexure, descending colon, sigmoid colon)

nodes_examined.label: Lymph nodes examined
nodes_examined.desc: number of lymph nodes examined and the number involved as written in the resection histopathology (for example 3 of 15)

obstruction_perforation.label: Obstruction or perforation
obstruction_perforation.desc: whether the report records bowel obstruction or perforation, as written

tumour_site_stomach.label: Site in the stomach
tumour_site_stomach.desc: site of the tumour in the stomach as written (gastro-oesophageal junction, cardia, fundus, body, antrum, pylorus)

cdh1_result.label: CDH1 germline test
cdh1_result.desc: CDH1 mutation result as written (detected, not detected, or that the test is pending)

tumour_location_oesophagus.label: Tumour location in the oesophagus
tumour_location_oesophagus.desc: location of the tumour as written (upper, middle or lower third, gastro-oesophageal junction) and the distance from the incisors if given

siewert_type.label: Siewert type
siewert_type.desc: Siewert type of a gastro-oesophageal junction tumour as written (I, II or III)

trg.label: Tumour regression grade
trg.desc: tumour regression grade after neoadjuvant therapy as written in the resection histopathology, with the grading system if named

lirads_category.label: LI-RADS category
lirads_category.desc: LI-RADS category of the liver lesion as written in the imaging report

hbsag.label: HBsAg
hbsag.desc: hepatitis B surface antigen result as written

anti_hcv.label: Anti-HCV
anti_hcv.desc: hepatitis C antibody result as written

hbv_core_ab.label: Anti-HBc
hbv_core_ab.desc: hepatitis B core antibody result as written

child_pugh_class.label: Child-Pugh class
child_pugh_class.desc: Child-Pugh class or score exactly as written by the clinician (never derive)

varices_finding.label: Varices
varices_finding.desc: oesophageal or gastric varices as written in the endoscopy report (present or absent, grade)

hvpg_mmhg.label: HVPG
hvpg_mmhg.desc: hepatic venous pressure gradient in mmHg as written

flr_percent.label: Future liver remnant
flr_percent.desc: future liver remnant volume as a percentage as written in the imaging or volumetry report

gb_mass.label: Gallbladder mass
gb_mass.desc: gallbladder mass or wall thickening as written in the imaging report, with its size

vessel_involvement.label: Vascular involvement
vessel_involvement.desc: involvement of the hepatic artery, portal vein or other vessels as written in the imaging report

bile_duct_involvement.label: Bile duct involvement
bile_duct_involvement.desc: involvement of the common bile duct or the biliary tree as written in the imaging report

cystic_duct_margin.label: Cystic duct margin
cystic_duct_margin.desc: cystic duct margin status as written in the cholecystectomy histopathology

he4.label: HE4
he4.desc: HE4 with unit (and the ROMA value if written)

brca_status.label: BRCA1 / BRCA2
brca_status.desc: BRCA1 / BRCA2 germline or tumour result as written (pathogenic variant detected, not detected, variant of uncertain significance, or that the test is pending)

p53.label: p53
p53.desc: p53 immunohistochemistry pattern as written (wild type, mutant or aberrant, null)

gleason_isup.label: Gleason score / ISUP grade group
gleason_isup.desc: Gleason score (primary + secondary) and ISUP grade group as written in the biopsy or prostatectomy report

positive_cores.label: Positive biopsy cores
positive_cores.desc: number of positive cores out of the cores taken, and the percentage of core involvement, as written

hrd_status.label: HRD status
hrd_status.desc: homologous recombination deficiency result as written

corrected_calcium.label: Corrected calcium
corrected_calcium.desc: serum calcium (corrected if written) with unit

embryonal_component.label: Embryonal carcinoma component
embryonal_component.desc: presence and percentage of embryonal carcinoma (and the other germ cell components) as written in the orchidectomy report

igcccg_group.label: IGCCCG risk group as recorded
igcccg_group.desc: IGCCCG prognostic group exactly as written by the clinician (never derive)

fertility_preservation.label: Fertility preservation
fertility_preservation.desc: whether sperm banking or another fertility preservation was discussed or done, as written

cord_mobility.label: Vocal cord mobility
cord_mobility.desc: vocal cord mobility as written in the laryngoscopy (mobile, impaired, fixed), each side

laryngeal_function.label: Laryngeal function
laryngeal_function.desc: voice, swallowing and airway status as written (stridor, aspiration, tracheostomy)

laryngeal_subsite.label: Laryngeal subsite
laryngeal_subsite.desc: subsite of the larynx as written (supraglottis, glottis, subglottis) and the structures involved

bethesda_category.label: Bethesda category
bethesda_category.desc: Bethesda category of the thyroid FNAC as written (I to VI)

thyroglobulin.label: Thyroglobulin
thyroglobulin.desc: serum thyroglobulin with unit, and the anti-thyroglobulin antibody if written

tirads.label: TI-RADS category
tirads.desc: TI-RADS category of the thyroid nodule as written in the ultrasound report

extrathyroid_extension.label: Extrathyroidal extension
extrathyroid_extension.desc: extrathyroidal extension as written in the imaging or histopathology report (present, absent, minimal, gross)

b_symptoms.label: B symptoms
b_symptoms.desc: fever, night sweats or weight loss (B symptoms) as written: present or absent

molecular_markers_haem.label: Molecular markers (blood cancer)
molecular_markers_haem.desc: molecular results of a blood cancer as written (for example BCR-ABL1, FLT3, NPM1, PML-RARA, MYD88, IGHV), with the method

bone_marrow_result.label: Bone marrow result
bone_marrow_result.desc: bone marrow aspirate and biopsy conclusion as written (cellularity, blast percentage, involvement)

deauville_score.label: Deauville score
deauville_score.desc: Deauville five-point score as written in the PET-CT report

csf_cytology.label: CSF cytology
csf_cytology.desc: cerebrospinal fluid cytology result as written (positive or negative, cell count)

flow_cytometry_result.label: Flow cytometry result
flow_cytometry_result.desc: immunophenotype conclusion of the flow cytometry as written (lineage, markers expressed)

cytogenetics_result.label: Cytogenetics / FISH result
cytogenetics_result.desc: karyotype or FISH result as written (for example t(9;22), t(15;17), del(17p), MYCN)

anaplasia.label: Anaplasia
anaplasia.desc: presence or absence of anaplasia (focal or diffuse) as written in the histopathology of a Wilms tumour

loh_1p_16q.label: LOH 1p / 16q
loh_1p_16q.desc: loss of heterozygosity at 1p and 16q as written

ophthalmic_examination.label: Eye examination
ophthalmic_examination.desc: findings of the examination under anaesthesia or the ophthalmic examination as written (tumour size, location, seeding, both eyes)

rb_group.label: Retinoblastoma group as recorded
rb_group.desc: International Classification of Retinoblastoma group (A to E) exactly as written by the ophthalmologist (never derive)

germline_result.label: Germline test result
germline_result.desc: germline genetic test result as written (for example RB1), or that the test is pending

sarcoma_fusion.label: Fusion / translocation (sarcoma)
sarcoma_fusion.desc: fusion gene or translocation result as written (for example EWSR1-FLI1, SS18-SSX, PAX3-FOXO1), with the method

percent_necrosis.label: Necrosis after chemotherapy
percent_necrosis.desc: percentage of tumour necrosis in the resection specimen after neoadjuvant chemotherapy as written

tumour_depth.label: Tumour depth
tumour_depth.desc: depth of the soft tissue tumour relative to the fascia as written (superficial or deep)

idh_status.label: IDH status
idh_status.desc: IDH1 / IDH2 mutation result as written (immunohistochemistry or sequencing)

mgmt_promoter.label: MGMT promoter methylation
mgmt_promoter.desc: MGMT promoter methylation result as written

_phase2_note: Phase 2 (night-v3, 27 Oct 2026): the facts and document types from the Phase 2 checklist research (docs/night-v3/research/01_cancer_checklists.md) were added for the new draft checklists; the new document types are bone_marrow, flow_cytometry, cytogenetics, csf, echocardiogram, ophthalmology_note and audiometry.
